annotations.title: Extract citation evidence from AI answer

description: Extract the cited snippet from the AI engine's raw answer for each citation. Calls check_citations, then for each returned URL finds the first mention in raw_answer and returns a context window plus the nearest quoted span or containing sentence. Use to see *why* an engine cited a URL, not just *that* it did. Returns 'not found' for engines without raw_answer (Bing, Brave).

context_chars.description: Half-width of the snippet window around each citation mention (chars). Total snippet is up to 2x this.

engine.description: AI engine to query. web_rank engines (bing_serp, brave_serp) lack raw_answer and return no evidence.

max_results.description: Max citations to extract evidence for.

query.description: Search query whose AI answer to extract citation evidence from.

name: citations_evidence

evidence.description: Per-citation evidence extracted from the raw answer.

found.description: Whether the URL was found in raw_answer.

nearby_quote.description: Nearest quoted span or containing sentence.

snippet.description: Context window around the first mention.

evidence_found.description: Citations whose URL was located in the raw answer.

has_raw_answer.description: Whether the engine returned a raw answer.

query.description: The query whose answer was analyzed.

raw_answer_chars.description: Length of the engine's raw answer.
